'''Infobox proposal B''' sandbox, pass 5. Live [[Template:Card]] is unchanged. Tests use [[Template:Card/sandbox]].

One Info list. Title carries uniqueness dots. Force Icons are separate from Icons. Versions is last. The current Versions row is marked as the current printing. Publisher sits after Set. Era wikilinks the era hub.

Versions prefixes: Decipher, Decipher (AI), Virtual Original, Virtual Legacy, Virtual Legacy (AI), Virtual Modern, Virtual Modern (ALT). The article title and GEMP ID carry the rest.
